caption: Lightning flashes over a wet city street at night, and the flash is mirrored in the puddles and the wet pavement.

sa.check: A city street at night with wet pavement and puddles.
The flash is mirrored in the puddles and the wet pavement.
The mirrored flash appears with the flash in the sky, not before it.

pc.expect: The flash is brief; the sky and its reflections return to dark together; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The sky stays lit for the rest of the clip; or the reflection remains lit after the sky is dark; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The reflections lie in the wet surfaces below the lit sky, with the dark shapes of buildings between; they appear only during the flash.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while puddles and pavement stay as dark as before; or the puddles brighten while the sky stays dark; or the bright patch in a puddle sits under a building where no sky is above it; or the reflection appears before the sky flashes.

pc.expect: Streetlights, lit windows and signs keep their steady glow through the flash; nothing in the street moves at the flash.
pc.fail: Streetlights blink out at the flash or all change together; or lit windows go dark at once; or parked cars or bins shift at the flash.

pc.expect: Buildings, cars and street furniture are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Buildings or cars appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or puddles appear or vanish between frames; or a sign changes place.

pc.expect: The street stays a street: the puddles are thin water on a solid surface, buildings keep their shape and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A puddle swallows an object; or a building changes shape; or a bolt passes through a building and lights its inside; or the street surface ripples like open water.

pc.expect: Building and sign colours and the pavement stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: Signs change lettering or colour; or buildings change colour; or a puddle changes shape while nothing disturbs it.
